name: Email Ownership
summary: Describes whether an email address is absent, asserted, or independently verified as owned by the identity being resolved.

values.name: Asserted
values.summary: An email was supplied or asserted by an external provider, but NuvIoT has not independently verified ownership.

values.name: Verification Pending
values.summary: A NuvIoT email-verification ceremony is active.

values.name: Verified
values.summary: Ownership of the canonical email was independently verified by the NuvIoT authentication ceremony.

values.name: Conflict
values.summary: Verified or asserted emails conflict and require resolution.

sourceReferences.note: RegisteredEmail and VerifiedEmail remain distinct; provider email is supporting evidence and never substitutes for VerifiedEmail.
Approved policy treats email as a trusted identity anchor only after NuvIoT verification; provider email assertions cannot authorize linking by themselves.
